_about: Register for copy.claims.unsourced (RUBRIC D25). One entry per flagged claim that is sourced. basis: code = the copy states a branch or constant the code computes (evidence is that code); design = a UI label or empty-state text with no factual claim beyond the label (design says so); measurement and hitbox are not used. Claims that cannot be verified from code are deliberately absent, so they stay counted: lag bands in controller.ts (no measurement artifact in the repo), privacy.ts, Sweaty Bois/Team Madness/Proving Grounds map claims in news.ts, and the other unverified copy listed in the QA report.
